priority_findings.gap: The current driver requires parity_row_id to be a selected training example with at most512 total tokens. A truly broad unconditioned R draw, its2048-row prefix, or an independently selected S subset need not contain such a short row. The existing four-witness preparation proves only that short examples exist in the broad population.
priority_findings.recommended_resolution: Before drawing or scoring outcomes, prospectively version a future driver/cache ABI to bind one fixed original-source parity-only witness outside the training examples/consumption ledger. Seal its unchanged bytes, original tokenizer/EOS serialization, source and exclusion identities and selection rule. Use that same witness across all cells; exclude it from examples seen, gradients, updates, training-token exposure and data-selection claims. Native actual-driver checks must exercise the new ABI before any pilot.
priority_findings.prohibited_shortcuts: Do not insert a parity example into R/S, redraw or refill a random sample, condition broad eligibility on short length, duplicate a training example, or reinterpret a diagnostic witness as a training presentation. If the current ABI is retained instead, a missing in-draw short witness must stop the prospectively sealed attempt without redrawing.

priority_findings.gap: A successful repeated-four-witness joint diagnostic can supply the long_after_adam_admission shape receipt. It is not the separately required accumulation8_admission receipt from the actual pilot_driver integration_diagnostic stage. The main driver deliberately rejects repeated canonical training IDs.
priority_findings.recommended_resolution: Prepare a separate17-unique-row, complete native512-token integration cache, with unequal active target lengths and deterministic predeclared ID/order selection after the same reserved-source plus all-nine benchmark exclusions. If17 suitable unique rows do not exist, stop and prospectively resolve the diagnostic design; do not reuse the four witnesses repeatedly or silently substitute rows. Use the actual driver and its current/new prospective ABI to run8+8+1 presentations and3 updates, final save/reload only, with fresh original weights.
priority_findings.per_objective_binding: Obtain separately bound successful actual-driver integration evidence for sft/beta0, ce_kl/beta0.05, asft/beta0.05 and prior_anchored/beta0.05, with identical fixed precision/backend/chunking/GA8 settings. A different objective/beta cannot borrow a receipt. The CE half-LR cell also needs its exact prospective LR vector bound by CPU schedule oracles; do not claim a beta/objective or recipe not actually tested.
priority_findings.required_native_evidence: Bind plan/cache/code and current job; exact unique once-only consumption, equal-example8+8+1 tail scaling, LR/scheduler/save boundaries, finite434 trainable tensors/moments, isolated unchanged reference, checkpoint isolation/reload, native serialization, actual headroom and terminal accounting. Short-only integration does not replace the separate sufficiently long post-Adam forward with434 resident gradient tensors and an earlier backward in that update.

priority_findings.gap: Pure render/extract/grade/sample helpers and a CPU calibration prompt cache do not implement actual source generation, a complete eight-sample result manifest, role aggregation or its GPU admission.
priority_findings.smallest_next_source_stage: After successful source-readiness-v2, separately freeze and natively test a minimal source-generation collector using only the sealed32 calibration records and original model. Consume private verified prompt_token_ids; keep labels entirely outside generation. Resolve exact vLLM/model/tokenizer/runtime settings and actual EOS151645; bind record seed, sample index0..7, engine output index, prompt/model hashes, raw text/tokens, finish/stop reasons and response hashes. Run one original-model calibration pass under the unchanged n8/8192-new/16384-context profile and no extra stops, with a separately admitted finite bound and no automatic downstream job.
priority_findings.engineering_acceptance: All32 requests and256 samples must be complete, unique and paired to immutable prompt/protocol identities. Extraction failure is incorrect, length finish remains counted, abort/worker error/timeout is nonrankable and retains its denominator, and cleanup error is persisted privately then aborts the caller. Persist raw evidence privately and public aggregate/hash metadata only. Measure throughput, token counts, memory and maximum-length behavior; calibration accuracy must not select prompts, caps, seeds, parsers or recipes.
priority_findings.repair_boundary: An evidenced implementation failure may justify a separately bound repair with its original receipt preserved. Poor accuracy, unboxed responses or long reasoning are model outcomes and do not authorize repeated calibration tuning or replacing the sealed records.

priority_findings.gap: The CPU source audit serialized four witnesses, not the full eligible population, the15000-row R/S draws or the2048-row pilot caches. The complete original-base compatibility scores and fresh full-population coverage features are not established by old scores or old cluster64 sentinel labels.
priority_findings.recommended_resolution: Freeze a CPU full-population source/cache/feature plan first: apply both immutable exclusion components before fitting, scoring or selection; validate native complete32768 serialization and EOS/tail without truncation, dropping, rewriting or refill; seal all82961 eligible IDs and input hashes. Fit the proposed question-only coverage features on that entire eligible population with exact libraries/order/seed/rank guards. Separately admit one frozen-original full-supervised-token mean-CE score for every eligible original target, including its native EOS/tail and excluding prompt labels. Bind complete score coverage, finite values, active counts, exact model/tokenizer/code and measured throughput. No old prefix loss or partial-score fallback.
priority_findings.selection_freeze: Draw R once uniformly without replacement from sorted broad eligible IDs with the predeclared seed; preserve order. Seal S topic-by-full-length quotas matched to R, fixed half-low-CE plus seeded-coverage membership, tie/seed namespaces, R/S overlap and tags. Seal nested R/S2048 subsets and matched cell-order exposure before outcomes. The lower-CE component measures base compatibility, not verified target correctness or guaranteed learning value.

priority_findings.gap: Seven-cell definitions and ranking/promotion statements remain proposals, and source-only helpers do not yet establish complete per-role scoring/aggregation or finishable end-to-end reservations.
priority_findings.recommended_resolution: Seal exact seven cells, one ranking checkpoint256, controls, source-development roles, all per-domain retention/length/repetition gates, tie order and the random-only-winner policy before any pilot generation. Retain checkpoint64 for diagnostics only. Direct combined selection-method promotion is supported only for S_CE or S_KL with their matching R control; an R_ASFT/R_PRIOR/R_halfLR winner cannot be silently transferred to S or trigger an automatic eighth cell.
priority_findings.evaluation_preflight: Prepare the fixed768-record development prompt cache and validate its source gold/extraction support before pilot outcomes, while keeping prompts gold-blind and complete. Do not inspect or tune to independent confirmation answer formats during this engineering stage. An unsupported or failed grader state stops readiness rather than dropping/refilling a question. Freeze whole-group shard identities, output inventory, record-weighted within-domain p1=c/8 and p8=any-correct, then equal-domain aggregation and paired component uncertainty. Require all declared samples and roles before ranking.
priority_findings.deadline_and_claim_limits: Measured original calibration throughput alone is not a safe collapsed-model decode bound. Reserve bounded complete training and source generation, full replication, one confirmation and unchanged final benchmarking with the48-hour closeout reserve before admitting an unfinishable pilot campaign. Matching coarse cells/example counts does not match exact supervised-token exposure; report per-arm active-token totals and all regressions.

scientific_limits: Teacher-forced base KL need not preserve sampled free-generation prefixes; source8K development is a deliberate proxy for unchanged32K final benchmarks.
ARC is a retention guard, not GPQA or Chinese-domain equivalence. Passing source gates cannot establish every final benchmark or metric improves.
Two fixed training seeds and unadjusted conditional component bootstrap intervals do not establish general training-seed variance or universal superiority.
Official tests have already been viewed historically; preserve that exploratory history even when the new selection/confirmation round is prospectively frozen.
A pending or partly complete diagnostic is not a successful memory, numerical, consumption or generation result. No new benchmark score, recipe improvement or SOTA claim is made here.
